The package provides `diakonos` and conflicts with `diakonos-git`, which is standard practice to avoid file conflicts between binary and development versions.

No obfuscated commands, unexpected network calls, or file operations are present. The content aligns with standard AUR packaging practices for a VCS-sourced, Ruby-based application. There are no signs of supply chain compromise in this metadata file.

This is consistent with standard Ruby installation practices and does not involve any obfuscated or suspicious commands.

No network operations, code downloads, or execution of external scripts occur during the build or package phase. All dependencies are standard Ruby libraries.
